programs.title: Weather Command
programs.desc: Going inside the Weather Command Center for America's forecast authority for all the latest breaking weather news; tracking every storm as fox weather meteorologists, contributors and correspondents deliver real-time weather alerts and forecasting.

programs.title: America's Weather Center
programs.desc: From the forecast center of fox weather hear from meteorologists from across the country with the latest weather news; share your lunchtime with fellow weather enthusiasts and our experts.

programs.title: FOX Weather Now
programs.desc: Ian Oliver delivers the up-to-the-minute play-by-play of the nation's weather news; Ian and friends use their experience and expertise to interpret the latest forecasts and give perspective on the day's weather news.

programs.title: FOX Weather Live
programs.desc: Steve Bender hosts from Studio W, the heart of fox weather, as extreme weather strikes; Steve provides real-time alerts and information to keep you and your family safe and get you ready for the next day ahead.
